description: After completing a Stripe SetupIntent with Stripe.js, reconcile the authenticated machine's saved-card authorization with Stripe. Use the authorization_id returned by create_card_authorization; this may activate the permission only after successful setup and ownership checks, and never charges a card. Do not use it to initiate setup (create_card_authorization) or reconcile an order payment (sync_card_payment).

authorization_id.description: Saved-card permission ID from create_card_authorization for this machine.

name: sync_card_authorization
title: Verify completed card setup
